page.eyebrow: PoC · talking to NPCs in the 3D campus
page.title: Talk to the campus characters
page.lead: Walk up to a character and press E to talk. Each question carries only the last 3 exchanges, and the server checks the persona against an allow list. In this demo the answers are simulated: no AI is called.
page.sceneLabel: 3D campus with {count} buildings and {npcs} characters. {mode} mode.
page.keysMove: W/S or ↑/↓: walk · A/D or ←/→: turn · C: Avatar ⇄ Orbital
page.keysInteract: Near a building: I info · E enter the room
page.keysHelp: H: student guide · Esc: close the open window

hud.prompt: Press [E] to Enter or [I] for Information
